company.name: NexDash
company.description: Aims to scale zero-emission logistics infrastructure across Europe, creating a new class of freight carriers.

key_people.name: Joern-Carlos Kuntze
key_people.quote: Electrification in heavy-duty transport doesn’t fail because of technology, but because of orchestration. NexDash integrates software, infrastructure, and capital where it matters most – in operations.

company.name: NestAI
company.description: Developing artificial intelligence technologies for defence and critical infrastructure.

company.name: Rift
company.description: Offers a sovereign, on-demand aerial intelligence network powered by autonomous, long-endurance drones.

company.name: Logistica OS
company.description: Develops AI-powered agents explicitly designed to automate repetitive workflows within supply chain operations.

key_people.name: Flavio Alario
key_people.quote: We started Logistica OS to give logistics teams the software they deserve. Tools that take away the daily chaos and make operations faster, more straightforward, and genuinely enjoyable to run.

key_people.name: Mey Cezairli
key_people.quote: Logistics is under-digitised and under-automated for a reason. It’s incredibly complex, with messy workflows, countless edge cases, and quirks in every warehouse, partner, and delivery.

key_people.name: Cristian Pinto
key_people.quote: By being AI-native, Logistica OS is unlocking automation of repetitive processes that can unlock dozens of billions in productivity gains for retailers.

company.name: Kaaj
company.description: An agentic AI credit intelligence platform that automates small business loan underwriting from application to decision-ready analysis.

key_people.name: Kanyi Maqubela
key_people.quote: Small business lending has long struggled with a fundamental economics problem: the cost to underwrite smaller loans hasn’t matched the returns, leaving millions of businesses underserved.

key_people.name: Jake Gibson
key_people.quote: We’re backing a team with the rare combination of deep AI expertise and domain knowledge in credit risk to build the infrastructure that will power the next generation of small business finance.

key_people.name: Sheel Mohnot
key_people.quote: What impressed us most was Kaaj’s approach to building transparent, audit-ready AI that enhances rather than replaces human judgment.

company.name: Dost
company.description: AI-powered financial automation platform addressing inefficiencies in mid-market finance operations.

key_people.name: Adam Barbera
key_people.quote: Our philosophy is to build technology that becomes indispensable by becoming invisible.

key_people.name: Uthish Ranjan
key_people.quote: Dost is an AI-native platform tackling one of finance’s most entrenched inefficiencies — invoice processing.

company.name: Big Rentals
company.description: Offers HQ Rent, an AI-driven platform that consolidates scheduling, payments, and fleet management into a single software solution.

key_people.name: Pablo Fernandez
key_people.quote: For too long, local rental companies and small business owners have had to stitch together outdated tools, paper, and spreadsheets.

key_people.name: Sonia Nagar
key_people.quote: Big Rentals is transforming an overlooked yet essential backbone of our economy.

company.name: Poppy Flowers
company.description: Addresses floral supply chain issues with a technology-driven platform that brings transparency and modern design to wedding florals.

key_people.name: Cameron Hardesty
key_people.quote: Poppy was built from my own experiences and the belief that wedding florals could be radically better – for couples, for florists, and for the industry at large.

key_people.name: Meagan Malm
key_people.quote: Poppy continues to prove how technology can revolutionise even the most traditional industries.

key_people.name: Christopher Langford
key_people.quote: Poppy continues to redefine what’s possible in the wedding and floral industries.

company.name: Project Prometheus
company.description: An artificial intelligence company leveraging AI to help design and manufacture in fields like computing hardware, automotive, and aerospace.

key_people.name: Scott Chou
key_people.quote: Jeff Bezos getting back into the trenches is exciting, and it tells you he sees a real opportunity.

company.name: Cellbyte
company.description: Provides pharmaceutical teams with a single AI-driven system that centralises all information to address drug launch bottlenecks.

key_people.name: Felix Steinbrenner
key_people.quote: The success of a drug’s entire lifecycle is decided in its launch sequence.

company.name: Peec AI
company.description: Marketing platform providing visibility into how AI platforms describe products and the sources influencing those descriptions.

key_people.name: Marius Meiners
key_people.quote: We are obsessed with precision. Clean data, clear workflows, and a UI that teams actually love to use.

key_people.name: Henri Tilloy
key_people.quote: AI search is rewriting the rules of discovery, and Peec AI is the team redefining how brands show up in that new landscape.
